title: Strict and derived normalized reduction comparison interfaces
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E/Q_ell, and a scheme T. Use the existing integral section ring, normalized reduction record and strict coefficient towers. Define their canonical sequence-site realization and the same ordinary and derived tensor operations. SpReductionMonoidalData records the source and target closed tensor models, normalized symmetries and coherence, the derived tensor comparison, strong monoidal data, ordinary tensor balancing and a natural chain isomorphism. SpReductionMonoidalTower adds its tensorator, forward/inverse generator, summand, total/system/level K-flat and derived representative equations. SpReductionPullbackData and SpReductionPullbackTower record the actual integral, level and sequence inverse images and their constant-section, completion-projection, system-ring, evaluation, ordinary-generator and derived-counit equations. SpReductionPullbackCoherence records normalized tensor pullback models, their monoidal structures and the tensor and unit commutative diagrams. These are exactly the existing interfaces, with all sections, universes, operations and equations unchanged; no existence assertion is part of this definition node.
